Full job description

Progressive is dedicated to helping employees move forward and live fully in their careers. Your journey has already begun. Apply today and take the first step to Destination: Progress.

As a customer experience strategy manager within the Commercial Lines Customer & Agent Experience organization, you will own our Automation & AI portfolio, helping identify opportunities to simplify work, improve customer and agent experiences, and deliver measurable business value through automation, AI, and operational improvements. You’ll lead a team of three individual contributors to execute the team's roadmap and partner across Commercial Lines Customer & Agent Servicing (CAS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), IT, Data Science, Product, and Experience teams to prioritize and deliver high-value solutions. Additionally, you will be responsible for building business cases, defining success measures, and monitoring outcomes to ensure value delivery.

This is a remote position with occasional travel for meetings and/or training.

Must-have qualifications

A minimum of 9 years of related professional work experience (e.g., definition and delivery of products through digital, voice, and agent channel experiences) and at least 2 years of leadership experience (e.g., directly managing or mentoring).
{OR} Bachelor's degree or higher and a minimum of 6 years of related professional work experience (e.g., definition and delivery of products through digital, voice, and agent channel experiences) and at least 2 years of leadership experience (e.g., directly managing or mentoring).

Preferred skills

Demonstrated strategic and analytical leadership with the ability to solve complex business problems
Strong influencing skills across teams and organizational boundaries
Experience leading initiatives related to process improvement and automation-related initiatives
Ability to translate ideas and strategies into action and results
Experience with AI-related work
Experience leading technology, digital experience, operations, product management, or business strategy initiatives

Compensation

$102,800 - $146,900/year
Gainshare annual cash incentive payment up to 40% of your eligible earnings based on company performance.

Benefits

401(k) with dollar-for-dollar company match up to 6%
Medical, dental & vision, including free preventative care
Wellness & mental health programs
Health care flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, & life insurance
Paid time off, including volunteer time off
Paid & unpaid sick leave where applicable, as well as short & long-term disability
Parental & family leave; military leave & pay
Diverse, inclusive & welcoming culture with Employee Resource Groups
Career development & tuition assistance
Onsite gym & healthcare at large locations

Energage recognizes Progressive as a 2025 Top Workplace for: Innovation, Purposes & Values, Work-Life Flexibility, Compensation & Benefits, and Leadership.

Equal Opportunity Employer

For ideas about how you might be able to protect yourself from job scams, visit our scam-awareness page at https://careers.progressive.com/pages/how-we-hire-faq-job-scams/

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without the need or potential need, of current or future sponsorship for employment. Progressive does not hire candidates with (e.g., F-1 CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT, H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN) statuses for this role.
